story_description: As a hook developer, I want a comprehensive reference for all environment variables available to hooks so that I can write portable, reliable hooks that work correctly across different environments and CLI sessions.
task_description: Implement the HookEnvironment enum with Variable struct containing all environment variables (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, CLAUDE_ENV_FILE, CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE), availability metadata, and best practices documentation as a Swift reference type.
atom_description: Create the HookEnvironment.swift file containing the HookEnvironment enum with Variable struct (name, description, example, availability, critical fields), static allVariables array with all four environment variables, and static bestPractices array with six portability and security guidelines for hook developers.
problem_statement: Hook developers currently have no structured reference for environment variables available during hook execution. Without clear documentation of variable names, their availability per event type, and whether they are critical, developers write fragile hooks with hardcoded paths, miss important variables like CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE for remote detection, and do not follow portability best practices.
scope_in: HookEnvironment enum as namespace for environment variable reference
Variable struct with id, name, description, example, availability array, and critical boolean fields
Variable struct conforming to Identifiable and Sendable protocols
Static allVariables array containing four Variable instances for CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, CLAUDE_ENV_FILE, and CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE
Static bestPractices string array with six hook development guidelines
Full documentation comments on all public types and properties
scope_out: Runtime environment variable resolution or injection
Environment variable validation at hook execution time
UI components for displaying environment variables (separate atom)
Environment variable editor or custom variable creation
Environment variable inheritance from parent process
assumptions: Environment variables follow Claude Code CLI naming conventions with CLAUDE_ prefix
All events receive CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT variables
CLAUDE_ENV_FILE is only available in SessionStart event
CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE is set when running in container or remote SSH environment
Variable availability metadata is based on Claude Code CLI documentation
constraints: Struct must be Sendable for use in async hook execution contexts
Struct must be Identifiable using name as id for SwiftUI list rendering
Enum must be public for access from UI and hook runner components
Example values must use realistic but generic paths without user-specific data
Availability arrays must match actual Claude Code CLI behavior
